kpis.title: Key Performance Indicators
kpis.description: Shows your most important business metrics at a glance: total revenue, number of orders, average order value, and cancellation rate. Each metric includes a percentage change comparing the current period to the previous period.

insights.title: AI Insights
insights.description: AI-generated observations about your business performance, highlighting best-selling items, customer retention rates, and top-performing categories.

salesTrends.title: Sales Trends
salesTrends.description: A line chart showing your revenue and order volume over time. Toggle between revenue and orders to track how your sales are trending across the selected period.

topItems.title: Top Selling Items
topItems.description: Your best-performing menu items ranked by revenue. Shows each item's quantity sold and growth percentage compared to the previous period.

categoryPerf.title: Category Performance
categoryPerf.description: Breakdown of revenue by menu category. Bars show each category's contribution to total revenue, with status indicators for performance level.

customerAnalytics.title: Customer Analytics
customerAnalytics.description: Overview of your customer base including total customer count, returning customer percentage, and your top customer by order value.

operationsPerf.title: Operations Performance
operationsPerf.description: Tracks operational efficiency metrics like average preparation time, delivery time, and order completion rate compared to targets.

deliveryAreas.title: Top Delivery Areas
deliveryAreas.description: Geographic breakdown of where your orders are being delivered, showing order volume and percentage share for each area.

paymentMethods.title: Payment Methods
paymentMethods.description: Distribution of orders by payment method, showing the percentage and order count for each method used by your customers.

businessScore.title: Business Health Score
businessScore.description: An overall health score for your business based on revenue growth, customer retention, and operational efficiency. Includes strengths, areas to improve, and trend indicators.

targetSegmentsHelp.title: Target Segments
targetSegmentsHelp.description: Choose which customer groups this discount applies to. Leave empty to apply to all customers. Segments include: New (registered < 30 days), Active (ordered within 14 days), Inactive (no order in 30 days), VIP (high spenders or frequent buyers), and At Risk (previously active but haven't ordered in 21+ days).

discountMessageHelp.title: Message
discountMessageHelp.description: The text displayed to customers when this discount is applied. Keep it short and clear, e.g. '20% off for new customers!' or 'Summer sale — 15% off all items'.

discountTypeHelp.title: Type
discountTypeHelp.description: Percentage (P) deducts a percentage from the price, e.g. 20 means 20% off. Fixed (FIXED) deducts a specific amount, e.g. 10 means $10 off regardless of the item price.

discountValueHelp.title: Value
discountValueHelp.description: The discount amount. For Percentage type, this is the percent off (e.g. 20 = 20% off). For Fixed type, this is the exact amount to subtract (e.g. 10 = $10 off).

discountDateHelp.title: Dates
discountDateHelp.description: Set a start and end date to limit when this discount is active. Leave both empty for a discount that never expires. If only a start date is set, the discount is active from that date onward. If only an end date is set, the discount is active until that date.

discountTimeRulesHelp.title: Time-Based Rules
discountTimeRulesHelp.description: Restrict this discount to specific days and hours. For example, enable this for a 'Happy Hour' discount that only applies Mon–Fri from 12:00 to 15:00. When disabled, the discount is available at all times.

discountStackingHelp.title: Stacking Mode
discountStackingHelp.description: Controls how this discount interacts with other active discounts. Highest: only the best discount applies. Lowest: only the smallest discount applies. Stack: all eligible discounts combine. Priority: discounts apply in order set by the manager. Exclusive: if this discount applies, no others can.

discountConditionsHelp.title: Conditions
discountConditionsHelp.description: Set rules that must be met before a customer can use this discount. Use AND to require all conditions, or OR to require at least one. Available conditions: First Purchase (never ordered before), Total Spent (minimum amount spent), Total Items (minimum items purchased), Total Orders (minimum orders placed), Account Age (days since registration), and Days Since Last Order (days of inactivity).

minOrderTotalHelp.title: Min Order Total
minOrderTotalHelp.description: The minimum order subtotal (before tax and delivery) required for this discount to apply. For example, setting this to 50 means the customer must spend at least 50 to qualify. Leave at 0 for no minimum.

minCartItemsHelp.title: Min Cart Items
minCartItemsHelp.description: The minimum number of items in the cart required for this discount to apply. For example, setting this to 3 means the customer must have at least 3 items. Leave at 0 for no minimum.

businessScore.lowRetention: Low customer retention rate. Consider loyalty programs.
businessScore.lowCompletion: Order completion rate is below target.
businessScore.slowPrepTime: Preparation time is slower than expected.
